item.title: Last week for Kids Section ‘2026
item.description: It’s the last week to submit entries for Metter Advertiser’s Kids Section 2026. Photos must be received by Friday, Jan. 30, at 5 p.m. Submit your favorite picture, along with information about your child(ren), including names, ages, and parents/ grandparents’ names, to news@metteradvertiser.com; put ‘Kids Section’ in the subject line. There is no cost to participate. The post Last week for Kids Section ‘2026 first appeared on Metter Advertiser.

item.title: County seats, BOE and ESPLOST up for vote this year
item.description: Candler County Board of Education voted during their regular January meeting to put a new ESPLOST on the ballot in 2026. The move would allow for the continuation of the penny education tax once the current ESPLOST expires.
